trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no shortcut: the last two to fall are usually the final-mission gold and the 100% completion gold, so treat this as the finish line of the roadmap, not a trophy you chase directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first main mission of the game, so it pops early in your first playthrough. Because the game has no mission replay, it is flagged here as chapter-gated: play it when the story presents it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapters close automatically as you finish their missions, so keep playing the main missions and this pops when the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: with no mission replay, a chapter-gated trophy is one you earn on the way through or not at all.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. This is the chapter where the second playable character joins, so play through its missions in order; the trophy pops as the chapter ends. Like every chapter trophy it is flagged chapter-gated because there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep following the main story missions through Chapter 3; the trophy lands when the chapter closes. Do the chapter's time-sensitive side content (the Yago race) while you are here, before moving on.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the chapter's main missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. The optional vault mission near the end of this chapter opens the bank-vault robberies, so do it before the credits.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus — then finish it and this gold pops. It is one of the last two trophies most players earn, just before the platinum.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops automatically when you finish the mission, and switching between the two playable characters opens right after it. Flagged chapter-gated because missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist as the story presents it; the trophy pops when the mission ends. There is no mission replay, so story-mission trophies are flagged chapter-gated in this guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends; play the story in order and you will reach it naturally.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission in the story's order and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown the story brings you to. Finish it and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission in story order and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which only appears after the story. Work you do before the credits still counts toward it, and the checklist is lenient — for example it asks for 300 of the 397 stunts and 70 of the 80 Challenges — so follow the roadmap stages and mop up the checklist at the end. This is the hardest trophy in the set and the last gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop. Stunt opportunities are spread all over Leonida; the beach and airport areas are good practice ground.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine are the game's side activities — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, gym training, drone races and hunting among them — so sample one of each rather than grinding any single one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, split across the game's two ranges. Learn each challenge's scoring, retry the ones you miss — ranges can be revisited any time — and the trophy pops when the last gold lands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. You only need one win per location, not every race, so move on as soon as a location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, drone races and other race types all count as long as each race is a different one, so work through the race list instead of repeating a favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on in a fishing contest and out-fish him; fishing is one of the nine activities, so you will meet it early in free roam.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a stranger questline that stays open after the story, so finish his missions in order and the trophy pops at his finale. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger missions to his finale; like the other side-character finales it stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger questline to its last mission. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (watch for the hourglass icon), so save first and race it the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand to its finale; side-story finales stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger strand to its finale. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots on the PSN counter. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The one to protect: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once that chapter ends, so follow her to the balcony and accept the optional task while you still can, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets and the trophy pops at the third completed set. Sweep each area as you explore it rather than saving all the hunting for the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to tag 100 different spots as you travel; it pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State, so tag as you go instead of doing a separate 100-stop tour.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play; the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so push past 50 and let the counter keep climbing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star level straight away, so bring your partner to one, then break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone until the stars clear. The trophy pops once you have left the heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner in, then hit three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade to just the red heat zone the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 and R3 while aiming); pick a group of enemies such as the guards at an illegal operation, use an assault rifle, and drop five before Focus ends. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count — get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops. Save first; the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' means the Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code inside, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and get clear of the heat zone — the trophy pops once you have left the red zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas on the PSN counter. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map; the counter fills as you uncover new ground, and it pairs with WAiNK tagging and vehicle scanning, so do all three on the same trips.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs on the PSN counter. Each gang holds operations around the state; rob one per gang. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view; it is a quiet moment trophy, so do it when you are passing through the beachfront. The launch guides list this one as not yet pinned down, but the description itself names the place and the act.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side — pick a showroom with a clear exit line and enough speed to break through. The launch guides list this one as not yet pinned down, but the description itself describes the act.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe's contents, blown open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — Jason and Lucia both reaching maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you; keep at it until both hit max Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing the criminal life and check the counter now and then.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name points at succeeding on a second attempt at something that went wrong the first time. The launch guides list this one as not yet pinned down, so treat any single claimed trigger as unconfirmed and check the linked guides for the confirmed step before hunting it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at a strange one-off event — the kind of thing that happens once, in one place. The launch guides list this one as not yet pinned down; check the linked guides for the confirmed trigger rather than hunting blind.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The plain reading of the description is a drive-by attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle that bowls targets over. The launch guides list this one as not yet pinned down, so treat the method as unconfirmed and check the linked guides for the pinned-down step.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so keep feeding bills through as you rob.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so ordinary spending on weapons, clothes, cars and food all counts — it will mostly take care of itself by the endgame.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 garages, bought in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
